name: Departures, Terminus
tagline: Every line ends on a steel buffer, the last one carrying the machine's Ready lamp, and one green wire runs from the box into a departures board.
concept: A station at night. Vera's steel line runs down Home from the box (the stop you are at) past the starters, Continue and setup, and ends on a T buffer. To do's rail runs on to the foot of the column, where its buffer carries the machine's Ready lamp, level with the 'Change here for' interchange that ends the steel branch on the right. One phosphor wire runs from the box's lit ring into a dot-matrix departures board. The tube's light (halo, blur, scanlines, breathing lamps, one afterglow along the wire) is only where something is live. Everything else is matte steel, bone and enamel.
companions: Steel (#9aa8a8 and the edge greys) is the metal: rails, buffers, rings, leaders, every hollow stop (Status contents and Settings rows included), and the row-hover wash with its sage (#869c78) 2px edge. Bone (#d6ccb6) is the engraved day numerals and the Settings roundel. Each section enamel has a job. Plans blue #8fb6d8 is on its starter edge, wash and pictogram, Coming up's roundel and lead, and the month chips. To do verdigris #86c4b4 is on its starter, its head and its 'Add something to do' plate. Ideas wheat #d6ca8a is on its starter, Lately added and the Ideas head plate. Wishes rose #d99ac0 is on the wishes roundel, the kid stops and Memory's roundel. Clay #d9a27c is on Family's roundel and the restaurant ring. Kind colours live only in each kind's ring (1.5px plus a 12% fill), and kind words are ink-2. Amber is only words ('was due…', '⚠ Needs a look', '▸ 1 needs a look'), Home's setup ring and a warn lamp. It is never a ring on a list.
decisions: Kept every object the judges asked to keep: the wire from the box's ring into the board, Vera's rail with the box as its first stop, the board with its big VT323 clock and dim rows, the 6.4rem trace, the interchange, the engraved day numerals, one square tick per To do row, the form's quiet rule with one lit stop, colour named back in, and the condensed Archivo display face with Plex Mono figures beside each sign.

A new system rule: every rail ends on a T buffer (a 22px steel bar with two bolts, one shared --buffer token), and one mark means one thing. Vera's line ends on a plain buffer. To do's rail runs to the foot of the left column and ends on the buffer that carries the Ready lamp. Settings' directory ends on the same buffer at Setup, replacing its lit, breathing phosphor lamp.

The left and right lines now end at the same height. The left column stretches to the right column's height (grid rows auto auto 1fr, with To do's checklist as a flex column), so the Ready foot sits level with the 'Change here for' interchange: a buffer opposite an interchange.

The phone board was rebuilt as a departures list. Each row is a one-line name (nowrap, ellipsis) over its time and date in Plex Mono at --t-label, dimmed to 62% and 55% phosphor. The radar moves beside the clock (next-text set to display: contents in a 2-column grid), so the next title fits on one line, and the clock and all three rows sit above the tab bar at 390px.

Home's and Plans' calendar note ('Google Calendar is not connected…') is now engraved in the board case's chin, as Ideas' radar legend is. That ties the note to the board and takes ~40px off the right column.

Trace: the axis moves to 4.85rem, ticks are 2.9rem and the next tick is 3.35rem (3px, hot), so they fill about 70% of the band. The animated 'beam' segment (the smear between +1W and +2W) is deleted from the markup and the sheet, so nothing on the trace moves.

Title: 'Tell Vera where we’re *headed.*', taking the critic's suggestion. It is a statement in the line's voice, and the departures metaphor makes 'headed' the lit word. The full stop sits inside the lit run (Manual's credited setting), with E1's two-layer halo. It reads on one line at 2.25rem condensed on desktop and two on the phone. No other line carries it.
title: Tell Vera where we’re *headed.*: it names who hears you and that FamilyDB's job is where the family is going next (plans, outings, what to do), in a departures board's own word.
measures: Full render: 0 hard checks failed. The one guideline missed is words changed (plans 40.5%, from the parent's restructure). ink_on_bg 13.18, brand_on_bg 15.1, brand #6dff9c unchanged (L .897 C .186 h 151.4). Green share of colour: home 86.5%, ideas 83.9%, status 81.8%, chat 23.8%. That is down from the parent's 91.7% on home, but well over the brief's 60% target. Hue entropy: home .394, ideas .34, status .31, chat .255. Bright green: home 3.6 per mille. Small targets: 0 under 44px on every page (home 63 targets, home-phone 62). No sideways scroll. Smallest text 12px (the section-sign figures). The sheet is 195,419 characters, after cutting every comment to about one line.
strengths: The line is now a system rather than a Home device. Rails end on buffers, the lamp-bearing buffer is the machine's Ready, and the same buffer ends Settings' directory, so one mark means one thing across pages.
Home's two columns end level: the Ready buffer on the left faces the interchange on the right, and the 200px hole under To do is gone.

The phone board reads like a real departures screen. Each name is one line, time and date sit under it in Plex Mono, the radar is beside the clock, and the clock and three departures are above the fold.
One light really holds now. The phosphor is the mark, 'headed.', the box's ring, the wire, the glass, NOW/Ready, Send/Add it and focus. Settings and Status have no amber rings and no stray lit lamps.
The trace is legible and still: tall ticks, a hot next tick, VT323 numerals and weekend gaps, with no glitch smear.
Ideas is tighter: 'SAVED' instead of a doubled word, no blank cursor row, a 10rem radar, and 'Save a thought for later' as a link beside the tabs. The table starts at about 650px.
weaknesses: Green share is still 81-87% on Home, Ideas and Status. The board's glass, the wire and Send dominate the coloured pixels, so the brief's 60% target is not met.

To do's rail now runs about 230px past the last task to reach the Ready buffer. That is the critic's 'move the Ready foot down' option, but it is a long empty run of steel, and it grows when there are fewer tasks.

The Ready foot still prints the limit ('up to $2.00 a day'), not today's spend, and Memory's figure is words ('what Vera keeps'), not a count. Home's view hands the template neither figure, and this harness cannot change routes.py.

In the Home still, the first board row shows its hover band and underline. That is the harness's pointer, left where the sign-in button was (about 859,366). It is not a rest state, but a judge looking at the still may read it as one.
The Ideas header board's left half is still mostly leaders across a wide glass.
revisions: Phone board (fix 1): rows are now a one-line name (nowrap, ellipsis) over time and date in Plex Mono at --t-label. They are dimmed to 62%, with the facts at 55% phosphor. The radar is 6.25rem and sits beside the clock, the title fits on one line, and the clock and all three rows are above the fold. I declined dropping the radar below 400px, because that would remove it from every phone.

One light off Home (fix 2): Status' contents rail and its rows have no amber rings, and 'Needs a look' is now a half-filled steel ring with amber words. Settings' Sign-in roundel is steel, and the amber '⚠ Needs a look' words carry the warning. I declined making Settings' Setup stop amber, because Setup is always listed, so amber would be false once setup is done. Instead Setup ends the directory on the same T buffer that ends Home's lines, so one mark still means one thing.

Board first row (fix 3): the next title is no longer underlined at rest, and the 2px underline appears only on hover and focus. The band on Home's first row in the still is the harness's pointer, left from the sign-in click. The first row carries no band at rest.

Ideas (fix 4): the unit is 'SAVED' ('12 SAVED · 10 on the radar'), the blank '> ▮' cursor row is gone, the radar is 10rem with tighter glass padding, and 'Save a thought for later' is a one-line link at the right of the tabs that opens full width below them. The table starts at about 650px.

Ready foot and interchange (fix 5): the foot now says 'up to $2.00 a day', and Memory's figure is set in Plex Mono as 'what Vera keeps' to match its neighbours. I declined adding today's spend and a memory count: Home's view (routes.home) does not pass them, the shared context processor does not either, and the brief limits me to templates and CSS. It is a two-line view change if the design wins.
Left column hole (fix 6): the Ready foot moved to the foot of To do's rail, and the column stretches so it ends level with the interchange. Vera's line keeps a plain T buffer at its own end.
Trace (fix 7): ticks fill about 70% of the band and the next tick is 3px and hot. The 'beam' segment is removed from both _ui.html and the sheet.

Starters and type (fix 8): starter pictograms take their page's colour (a specificity fix), the stacked month and weekday go from --label to --ink-2, and the title is the critic's 'Tell Vera where we’re *headed.*'.

Also: the calendar note moved into the board case's chin on Home, Plans and the Plans month page. Every multi-line comment in the sheet is cut to one line. STYLE-departures.md is rewritten for the buffers, the phone board, the chin note and the title.
crit: PHONE board (home-phone, .board-rows li under max-width 640px): the rows are 1.0625rem Plex Mono beside a time column and a date column, so every name wraps to two lines ('Mount St. Helens day…' is also truncated). They still run near full --screen brightness, and the board fills the whole first screen with only 2.5 rows showing. On the phone, put the time and date on one Plex Mono --t-label line under a one-line name (white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis): grid 'name name' / 'time date'. Apply the desktop dimming (color-mix(in srgb, var(--screen) 70%, #0b0f0d)) there too. Cut the radar to about 7rem or drop it below 400px, so the clock and all three rows sit above the fold.

ONE LIGHT is broken off Home. Settings: the 'Setup' row's stop is a lit, breathing phosphor lamp on an ordinary link, and 'Sign-in and security' wears an amber ring. Status: 'Connected to' and 'Worth a look' have amber rings on the contents rail, and the head legend has a half-filled amber ring. The brief says amber is never a ring or an outline (except Home's setup stop), and phosphor lamps are only NOW and Ready. Make those stops hollow steel (--edge) and let the existing amber words ('⚠ Needs a look', '1 needs a look') carry the warning. Settings' Setup stop should be the same amber-ringed stop as Home's 'Finish setting up', so one mark means one thing across pages.

Home board, first row (.board-rows .dep:first-child): at rest it carries a lighter band and an underlined title ('Mount St. Helens day trip'). Against the dim rows it reads as a stuck hover, and earlier panels marked down titles underlined at rest. Keep only its time hot (--phosphor-bright with E1's halo). Drop the band and the underline, and save the 2px underline for :hover and :focus-visible as the brief says.

Ideas head and header board. 'Ideas 12 IDEAS' says the word twice: make the unit 'SAVED' (or keep only '10 on the radar'). The board's left half is mostly empty leaders, plus a blank '> ▮' cursor row, and with the 'Save a thought' fold it pushes the first table row to about 790px. Drop the cursor row, take the radar from 12rem to 10rem, and tighten the board's padding. Set 'Save a thought for later' as a one-line link at the right of the All ideas / Restaurants tabs rather than a full-width plate. The table should start above about 680px.

Home's Ready foot shows '$2.00 a day' (the limit), but the buffer lamp's job is today's state. Hand spending into Home through the context processor that already feeds Settings' card ('About $0.00 spent today') and print 'OpenAI · gpt-6-luna · $0.00 of $2.00 today' in Plex Mono, matching the Status meter's own words. The interchange's three stops are not parallel either: give Memory a Plex Mono figure ('N kept', from the memory count) in place of 'Tell Vera something'.

Home's left column ends at about 1190px and the right at about 1400px, so there is a 200px dead hole under To do. Its own short rail with the NOW lamp is right, so fill the hole by moving content, not by stretching: move the buffer and Ready foot to the foot of To do's rail, making the whole left column one line that terminates at the bottom, or move the Ready foot down so it lines up with the interchange. Either way the left and right lines end at the same height, a buffer opposite an interchange.

Trace (.trace, Home and Plans): the ticks fill only the lower third of the new 6.4rem height, so most of the panel is dark, and a short bright smear sits on the axis between +1W and +2W (Plans, about x 450-540) that reads as a glitch in stills. Scale .tk heights to fill about 70% of the band, so the next tick (3px, hot) stands near full height under its numeral. Remove the stray segment, or make sure it is the afterglow and only ever runs NOW→next.

Starters and type details. The 'usually Plans/To do/Ideas' icons still render grey: tint .starter .icon with the starter's --c, as the brief names. The stacked month/weekday ('Sep'/'Sun', 0.75rem condensed in --label) is the faintest text on To do: raise it to --ink-2. The title's question 'What should Vera plan?' can be answered 'nothing'. If titles are being handed out across lines, a statement in the line's voice ('Tell Vera where we're headed.' with 'headed' lit) suits a departures board better. Keep the condensed setting either way.
